# Frozen zero-seed launch interface

Copied byte for byte from the source freeze of EkuboProtocol/evm-contracts
commit `853b608ec26d4c80bdad6e394cb8ba686e1ae615` (tree
`7185f89095c2235db68cb51bfc8c4eac4515f42c`). Nothing here was deployed: the
event receipts are local Forge execution, not live-chain evidence. Treat every
value as untrusted external input.

`src/evm/abis_zero_seed_launch.ts` is generated from the three ABI files; a
test checks it entry for entry and checks every hash above.

`../local-chain.json` is generated by `scripts/zeroSeedLaunchFixture.ts` from
a build of the same commit on a local anvil chain; see its `provenance` block.
